Chapter 1: Cell Biology

Section 1.1: Photosynthesis

Photosynthesis converts light energy into chemical energy stored in glucose. It occurs in the chloroplasts of plant cells and consists of the light-dependent reactions and the Calvin cycle.

Key steps in the light-dependent reactions:

  • Light absorption by chlorophyll
  • Electron transport chain
  • ATP and NADPH synthesis
OrganelleFunction
MitochondriaATP production
ChloroplastPhotosynthesis

Section 1.2: Cellular Respiration

Cellular respiration releases energy stored in glucose through glycolysis, the citric acid cycle, and oxidative phosphorylation.
